content.prompt: Precise single-frame edit of this original painted paper tiger gently holding a white cord attached to a tiny folded paper deer. Preserve full frame, both animal anatomies/identities, paper craft material and all background. Exactly FIVE localized single-object changes: 1 tiger tail TOP tip curls inward into a compact closed loop instead of open hooked end, same tail base/body. 2 tiny deer UPPER LEFT pointed ear folds DOWN sideways into a triangular flap, same head/other ear/body. 3 white cord halfway between deer and tiger mouth gains a clearly tied BOW KNOT with two small loops in the cord itself, preserve same cord path/end attachments. 4 brass paper-fastener just right of green spool has a TRIANGULAR aperture in its thin arm instead of round aperture; preserve gold folded head. 5 large brown button at bottom-right has one SINGLE cross-shaped cutout replacing its group of four holes, same button/rim. Five isolated coherent object-part differences, no object swaps, no specks or grain, no extra unrelated props. Return matching full landscape counterpart.

Edit ONLY large folded GOLD DIAMOND HEAD of this paper-fastener crop. Original convex pyramid with four triangular faces becomes a HOLLOW diamond frame: retain the same outer four points/outline, but fold the four gold faces inward to leave a large deep diamond-shaped open recess occupying center half of head, with clearly visible gold inner rim and dark cavity. Preserve thin flat arm to right, its existing hole, shadows/background/size/location exactly. One coherent gold fastener head structure changes, no added objects or grain. Return one painted crop.
